fact: LTA Chairman Massaquoi says private firms are helping extend the fibre-optic network from Buchanan to Rivercess, Sinoe, Maryland, Grand Gedeh and Nimba counties, with work ongoing to interconnect all regions; no contract is described.
LTA Chairman Massaquoi says the fibre line had already reached Loguatuo from Monrovia; no length or date given, so dated by publication.

CSquared, USAID and Digital Invest committed to building a 350 km backbone crossing 13+ towns in Margibi, Bong and Nimba counties and connecting Monrovia to the Ivory Coast and Guinea borders, partly on Liberia Electricity Corporation utility infrastructure.
CSquared describes the 350 km backbone as Liberia's first open-access fibre backbone, providing high-capacity long-distance transmission services to Liberian telecommunication operators.
